overview: Medford Comprehensive High School Building Committee Chair Jenny Graham and architect Matt Rice discussed the development of the draft space summary for the new Medford High School building project.

items.title: Introduction and Space Summary Overview
items.summary: Committee Chair Jenny Graham and architect Matt Rice introduced themselves, explained the purpose of the draft space summary, and noted that the document will be submitted to the MSBA by the end of February.

subject: High School Building Project Space Summary
